unit.title: Intermediate Maths Challenge
unit.about: 25 multiple-choice problems for Stage 9 and IGCSE. The final five are seriously hard.
unit.note: Written by the Camday teaching team in the style of national maths challenges. Not UKMT papers.

01.prompt: At a party, each of the 20 guests shakes hands exactly once with every other guest. How many handshakes are there?
Each of the digits 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 is used exactly once to make a five-digit even number. What is the largest such number?
The red dashed line is a line of symmetry. What is the smallest number of extra squares that must be shaded so that the shape is symmetrical about the line?
Maya is 6 years older than Jamal. In 8 years' time the sum of their ages will be 48. How old is Jamal now?
Which of these numbers is a multiple of both 3 and 4?
What is the value of 1234² − 1233²?
Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 140°. How many sides does the polygon have?
All the whole numbers from 1 to 200 are written down. How many times is the digit 9 written?
The clock shows 7:10. What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
What is 36% of 25?
Finn's mother is 5 times as old as Finn. In 12 years she will be 2 times as old as Finn. How old is Finn now?
5 apples weigh the same as 3 pears. A pear weighs 24 g more than an apple. How much does one pear weigh?
Matchsticks are used to make triangles in a row (alternately pointing up and down). How many matchsticks are needed to make 60 of them?
How many squares of any size can be found on an 8 × 8 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
A three-digit number has digits a, b, c (in that order), where a − c = 5. The digits are reversed and the new number is subtracted from the original. What is the result?
The number 1111001 is written in base 2. What is it in base 10?
The mean of 7 numbers is 16. When one more number is added, the mean becomes 18. What number was added?
How many pairs of positive whole numbers (x, y) satisfy 3x + 4y = 85?
An ant walks along the lines of a grid from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner of a 6 × 4 grid of squares, moving only right or up. How many different routes are there?
What is the value of 1² + 2² + 3² + … + 25² ?
How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word LEVEL?
Two whole numbers have highest common factor 3 and lowest common multiple 84. Neither number is equal to 3. What is their sum?
Two circles have the same centre and radii 2 cm and 3 cm. What fraction of the larger circle lies outside the smaller one?
What is the sum of the digits of 10²⁶ − 7?

02.prompt: Today is Thursday. What day of the week will it be in 63 days' time?
How many square numbers are greater than 222 and less than 1008?
What is the value of 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + … + 77?
Which of these is the largest?
What is the next number in this sequence? 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, …
Two numbers have sum 36 and difference 16. What is their product?
A rectangle has sides of length 6 cm and 8 cm. How long is its diagonal?
How many of the whole numbers from 1 to 100 are multiples of 3 or 5 (or both)?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
The pages of a book are numbered from 1 to 378. How many digits are printed altogether?
In a triangle, one angle is 90°. Another angle is 4 times the third angle. What is the size of the largest angle?
A photo measures 16 cm by 11 cm. It has a border 2 cm wide all the way round. What is the area of the border?
How many factors does 90 have? (Include 1 and 90.)
A 5 × 5 × 5 cube is painted on the outside and then cut into 125 small cubes. How many small cubes have no painted faces?
The price of a game goes up by 60%. Later the new price goes down by 50%. What is the overall change in price?
Tap A fills a tank in 6 hours. Tap B fills it in 9 hours. How long do they take to fill the tank together?
Which of these puts 2⁹⁰, 3⁵⁰, 5³⁵ in order, smallest first?
What is the remainder when 5⁵⁴⁰ is divided by 11?
The number 49! means 49 × 48 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 49! ?
A bag holds 4 red and 7 blue counters. Two counters are taken out at random, without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
For how many whole numbers n from 10 to 200 does n² end in the digit 4?
The product of three consecutive whole numbers is 3360. What is their sum?
A club has 6 boys and 5 girls. A team of 1 boy and 2 girls is chosen. How many different teams are possible?
A rectangle is divided into a 3 × 4 grid of unit squares. How many rectangles (of any size, including squares) can be seen?
What is the smallest whole number greater than 10 that leaves remainder 1 when divided by 8, remainder 0 when divided by 9 and remainder 4 when divided by 7?

A snail is at the bottom of a well 27 m deep. Each day it climbs up 7 m, but each night it slides back 1 m. On which day does it first reach the top?
Two fair six-sided dice are thrown. What is the probability that the total score is 3?
How many integers n (positive or negative) satisfy 46 < n² < 156?
